behaviour_contract: Broken cages increment the total, persist their broken initial state, set lidol_to_allocate=5 and allocate a medallion. The value5 is a nonzero request latch: DO_OBJECTS at1:487eb..48805 passes7 to allocate_toons and clears the latch. The medallion selects32+old cage count and saturates the stored count at6, freezes camera/engine and advances its own clocks/sounds until38. Toons scan fourteen slots from first type3 and use the seven exact launch-speed pairs; a requested count is not a pool-capacity proof. Cage-grid activation and fragment motion are separate. Preserve walking/falling/water/ceiling toon reactions and the timed cage-grid spawn.
